dataset: Jal Jeevan Mission - Har Ghar Jal
table_title: Status of households with tap water connection (as on date)
data_notes: Each district record includes the state name explicitly.

Household counts are stored as integers; coverage_percent is stored as a number and preserved as printed in the PDF. Some printed percentages differ by 0.01 percentage points from recomputation using the displayed household counts, so they are not silently changed.
coverage_status_category is populated only where the source table explicitly labels a section; otherwise it is null.

tap_water_cell_annotation_raw preserves the small unlabelled annotation shown in the tap-water-supply cell (for example, 0 or + 116). Its meaning is not inferred because the table provides no separate header for it.
State totals are preserved separately in state_summaries and are not included as district records.
